channel.title: Libya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Libya, every source cited.

item.title: UN extends Libya mission to October 2027
item.description: Security Council resolution backs efforts to unify state institutions and hold elections within two years.

item.title: Libyan dialogue group seeks judicial unity for elections
item.description: London talks focus on resolving institutional divisions to enable credible national votes.

item.title: Libya restarts Brega gas unit
item.description: Sirte Oil Company recovers 60 million cubic feet of gas for the supply network.

item.title: Tripoli court affirms judicial independence
item.description: The Tripoli Court of Appeals rejected attempts to fragment the judiciary and influence its rulings.

item.title: Tripoli drainage stations halt, 130 buildings at risk
item.description: Rainfall preparations continue amid warnings of infrastructure decay and building collapse in Libya's capital.
